source.notes: POST /sap/bc/adt/debugger/watchpoints?variableName=LV_ZERO, issued while watchpoint 1 (LV_TOTAL) was already armed. Answers 200 with the <dbg:watchpoints> list root containing exactly ONE row — the newly created watchpoint id="2", variableName="LV_ZERO" — not both watchpoints. This establishes that a create response is a per-call echo of the thing just created, never the session's full watchpoint set; the companion capture 938 (GET /debugger/watchpoints, not turned into a cassette here because it shares its method+path with watchpoint-list-after-hit and would collide in the fake-route matcher) shows the same moment in time with BOTH rows present. Captured against the $TMP probe class ZCL_I89_PROBE, suspended in IF_OO_ADT_CLASSRUN~MAIN. Redactions performed by the capture harness before this file was written: appliance host -> 203.0.113.10:50000 (RFC 5737), application-server hostname -> a4hsandbox, Authorization/Cookie/set-cookie header values stripped. sha256/byteLength in the source .meta.json are computed over the redacted body as stored.
